en.tagline: Design UI screens on a canvas, then build them in your code
en.summary: The ui-design skill designs screens on a UX Pilot canvas before any code is written. You can open and edit the designs there, then choose which screens to build. The skill then rebuilds the chosen screens in your project's own stack.
problem: Asking an agent to write a frontend often gives a generic look, and you only see the result after the code is written.
With this skill, the agent first makes screens you can see and edit on a UX Pilot canvas. After you choose which screens to build, the code follows the approved layout, spacing, type and copy.
fit: Redesigning a page, screen, landing page, dashboard or component
Reviewing and editing the look before code is written
Projects with an existing brand, colors and fonts to keep
unfit: Projects where you cannot use a UX Pilot account or its MCP server
Small code-only changes that need no visual design step
steps: Checks that the UX Pilot tools are connected, and gives setup steps if they are not.
Writes a short brief from the project's README, routes, copy and existing styles.
Creates the screens with UX Pilot, or writes the HTML itself and puts it on the canvas.
Gives you the canvas link and fixes problems the checks report, such as low contrast and clipped text.
Reads each screen you approve and rebuilds it in your project's stack, keeping its layout and copy.
On the free plan, HTML for screens UX Pilot designed cannot be read back, so the skill asks you to upgrade or accept a close rebuild from the picture.

zh.tagline: 先在画布上设计界面，再写代码实现
zh.summary: ui-design 技能会在写代码前，先用 UX Pilot 画布设计界面。你可以在画布上打开并修改设计稿，然后选定要实现的页面。技能会用你项目自己的技术栈重新实现这些页面。
problem: 直接让 AI 写前端，常得到千篇一律的样式，而且要等代码写完才能看到效果。
使用这个技能后，AI 会先生成你能看、能改的界面稿。你确认要做的页面后，代码会按确认的布局、间距、字体和文案来实现。
fit: 重新设计页面、界面、落地页、仪表盘或组件
想在写代码前查看并修改界面效果
项目已有品牌色和字体，需要保持一致
unfit: 无法使用 UX Pilot 账号或其 MCP 服务的项目
只需修改代码逻辑、不需要视觉设计的小改动
steps: 检查 UX Pilot 工具是否已连接，未连接时给出设置步骤。
根据项目的 README、路由、文案和现有样式，写一份简短的设计说明。
通过 UX Pilot 生成界面，或自己编写 HTML 并放到画布上。
提供画布链接，并修复检查报告中的问题，例如对比度不足和文字被截断。
读取你确认的界面，用项目自己的技术栈重新实现，保留布局和文案。
免费版无法读回 UX Pilot 生成界面的 HTML，此时技能会请你选择升级，或接受根据设计图还原的近似结果。
